steps.name: Sample structure QC
caveats: This is design-confirmation QC, not a result: no differential-expression claims may come from it.
If a sample is far from its group, state it here; the DE step's robust=TRUE fit mitigates but does not remove its influence, and the report must mention it.
steps.context: Inputs: /eval-four-models-v2-with-log-normalized-n6-s1-1/data/inputs/expression/log_expr.csv — 12000 x 13 CSV; first column is the gene identifier, the other 12 columns are samples. Values are log2(TPM + 1) as delivered by the core facility, i.e. already on the log scale: use them as-is, do not transform again. Metadata: /eval-four-models-v2-with-log-normalized-n6-s1-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv — 12 x 2, one row per sample with condition (6 treated, 6 control), unpaired, single batch. This step only confirms the design and sample quality; it does not select genes or drop samples.
steps.question: Do the 12 muscle samples (6 treated, 6 control) in log_expr.csv separate by condition on the delivered log2(TPM + 1) values, and are there outlier or identity-swapped samples to flag before the model is fitted?

grounding.reason: Sample structure QC on log abundance values: MDS or PCA, sample distances, detected genes per R-0071@e4e2

constraints: Do not transform the values: input is already log2(TPM + 1); transform = log2_plus_1_unless_already_log.
MDS or PCA on the 500 most variable genes (n_top_genes = 500), samples colored by condition from metadata.csv.
Sample distance heatmap and detected-gene count (or equivalent per-sample activity summary) for each of the 12 samples.
Do not apply a count-model variance-stabilizing transformation (it expects raw counts).
Do not drop samples in this step; any sample not clustering with its condition must be named for the model step.
steps.description: PCA/MDS and sample-distance QC of the 12 log2(TPM + 1) muscle samples colored by condition, on the delivered values without re-transformation.
acceptance_criteria: MDS or PCA plot of all 12 samples colored by condition (6 treated, 6 control) produced.
Per-sample summary computed for all 12 samples.
Any outlier, possible identity swap, or batch-like structure explicitly named; if none, that is stated.

steps.name: DE by limma: treated vs control
caveats: Never convert the delivered log values back to counts for a count model: DESeq2, edgeR, and voom require raw counts, and these are not available.
The filter must be independent of group labels.
robust = TRUE down-weights hypervariable genes; state the option in the method description.
If T1S1 flagged an outlier sample, the robust fit mitigates but does not remove it; carry the flag into the report.
steps.context: Inputs: same log_expr.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples, log2(TPM + 1)) and metadata.csv (6 treated vs 6 control) as T1S1. Design: single factor condition, no batch term (single batch), no other covariates. Reference level set explicitly to control; contrast treated vs control so a positive log2 fold change means higher expression in treated. The research question does not state a fold-change threshold, so the test is against zero and genes are selected by adjusted p-value only.
steps.question: Which of the 12000 genes differ in expression between the 6 treated and 6 control muscle samples?

grounding.reason: limma linear model on log-scale expression values per R-0075@4d16

constraints: Filter before the model (low abundance filter on log expression values): keep genes whose mean log expression is at or above a floor at the low end of the distribution and that are above the floor in at least 6 samples (min_samples = smallest group size); state the floor and the number of genes kept.
No normalization: values already carry the core facility's normalization (normalization = none_already_normalized).

Value range check required before fitting: expect log2-scale values (fractional, roughly 0 to 20). If the matrix instead looks like raw counts (integers in the thousands), stop and report it; do not run a count model on the delivered values.
Set the condition factor reference level explicitly to control; contrast treated vs control in factor numerator/denominator form.
Fit the limma linear model and run eBayes with robust = TRUE and trend = TRUE.
Select DE genes by BH-adjusted p-value < 0.05 from topTable (adjust.method = BH); do not select by unadjusted p-value or fold change alone.
Report n_tested (genes kept after filtering) and n_de (genes with adj.P.Val < 0.05).
steps.description: Low-abundance filter on mean log expression, then limma lmFit + eBayes (robust = TRUE, trend = TRUE) for treated vs control on log2(TPM + 1), BH-adjusted p-value at 0.05, full results table plus DE gene set.
acceptance_criteria: Value range check confirms log2 scale before model fitting.
Full results table for all retained genes: gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, PValue, adj.P.Val.
DE gene set defined as adj.P.Val < 0.05 for treated vs control, with its size reported.
Filter floor and number of genes kept after filtering stated.

steps.name: Report
steps.context: Combines T1S1 (QC findings: structure, any flagged samples) and T1S2 (results table, thresholds, gene counts) into one report. No gene-set collection or annotation release is used in this plan (no enrichment requested); state the input scale instead: producer = core facility, values = log2(TPM + 1), no re-normalization. No step uses randomness, so no seed is expected.
steps.question: What must the final report state so that this treated vs control differential expression analysis is reproducible?
constraints: The report names the method, each package with its version, the design formula, the contrast, the thresholds (adj.P.Val < 0.05), n_tested, and n_de.
Attach sessionInfo with all package versions, stored with the results, not in a separate note.
Record the random seed of any step using randomness (none expected; state that none was used).
State the input scale and that no normalization was applied in this analysis.
steps.description: Reproducibility report: method, package versions, design, contrast, thresholds, n_tested/n_de, sessionInfo, and the input-scale statement.
acceptance_criteria: A single report containing method, package versions, design, contrast, thresholds, n_tested, n_de, and sessionInfo.
Reproducibility record stored with the results.

plan.title: Treated vs control muscle DE by limma
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM + 1) normalized values, not counts, for 12 human muscle samples (6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch). Per the knowledge rules for log-scale input: no count model (DESeq2/edgeR/voom take raw counts), no re-normalization (values already carry the producer's normalization), and a limma linear model with trend = TRUE and robust = TRUE empirical Bayes moderation is the permitted method. The plan first confirms sample structure on the log values (no dropping), then filters low-abundance genes on mean log expression, fits the single-factor design with an explicit reference level (control) and a treated vs control contrast, selects genes by BH-adjusted p-value at 0.05 (no fold-change threshold was requested, so the test is against zero), and closes with a reproducibility report. The question asks only which genes differ, so no pathway/gene-set enrichment step is included.
